# fleetdm_mdm_eula (Resource)

Manages the end user license agreement (EULA) Fleet shows during MDM enrollment, one per platform. macOS (`darwin`) takes a PDF; Windows (`windows`, Fleet 4.94+) takes a Markdown (.md) file of up to 512 KB. Requires Fleet Premium and the platform's MDM turned on. Fleet has no in-place update, so a change to the file content or name replaces the EULA (delete, then upload). `create_before_destroy` is not supported: Fleet allows only one EULA per platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: FleetDM MDM end user license agreements (EULAs)
#
# Fleet keeps one EULA per platform. The file is hashed at plan time and is
# not stored in state; changing its content or name replaces the EULA.

# macOS: a PDF shown during automatic (ADE) enrollment.
resource "fleetdm_mdm_eula" "macos" {
  platform = "darwin"
  source   = "${path.module}/eula/terms.pdf"
}

# Windows (Fleet 4.94+): a Markdown file of up to 512 KB.
resource "fleetdm_mdm_eula" "windows" {
  platform = "windows"
  source   = "${path.module}/eula/terms.md"

  # Optional: the file name Fleet stores. Defaults to the base name of source.
  name = "acme-terms.md"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `platform` (String) The platform the EULA is for: `darwin` (a PDF) or `windows` (a Markdown file, Fleet 4.94+).
- `source` (String) Path to the local EULA file. The content is hashed at plan time and is not stored in state; a content change (a different `sha256`) replaces the EULA. Moving the file without changing it does not. A `source` that is only known at apply time (for example, a file another resource writes) replaces the EULA on every change to it, because its content cannot be compared at plan time.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The file name Fleet stores and shows. Defaults to the base name of `source`. Windows names must end in `.md`. It must be a bare file name of at most 255 characters (no path separators or control characters), since Fleet strips those. Changing it replaces the EULA.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the EULA was uploaded.
- `id` (String) The platform, which identifies the EULA.
- `sha256` (String) Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the EULA. Planned from the local file and refreshed from Fleet, so a change on either side replaces the EULA.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token Fleet uses in the EULA download URL. The download needs no other credential.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a platform's EULA by its platform: "darwin" or "windows".
terraform import fleetdm_mdm_eula.macos darwin
terraform import fleetdm_mdm_eula.windows windows
```
